verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents programmatic usage export through the FOCUS API, which is in Public Preview. Its billing insights break down billable usage by resource type, and the Managed Grafana Cost and Usage zone surfaces usage and costs. Nothing shows spend can be attributed by team or workload, and the API is still a preview. Missing for 10: per-team/per-workload cost allocation (e.g., label/tag- or project-based breakdowns), GA status and detailed reference docs for the FOCUS API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
